title: 1st IPC Interactive Meet on Pharmacopoeia Standards Regulatory and Quality Considerations - Postponed
bodyHtml: This is with reference to the subject matter noted above. The “1st IPC Interactive Meet on Pharmacopoeia Standards: Regulatory and Quality Considerations” scheduled to be held on November 16, 2018 at Vadodara, has been Postponed due to some unavoidable circumstances. The next date would be intimated in due course of time.
